title: disco: a toolkit for Distributional Control of Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Not directly evaluated in this paper's experiments, but described as a supported application of the toolkit (Distributional Control) where gender bias is reduced by defining a feature detecting a population of interest and setting target moments to a desired value.
